notes: §1985:VI.5.10.3 SR4: "This clause must not be used in level 01 entries in the Communication Section." BindEntry binds the record description entries that follow a CD entry in EntrySection.Communication, and ScreenRedefinesEntry, which Run asks of every REDEFINES clause whose data-name-2 resolved, refuses a subject that is a level-1 root of that section with COBOL2739; a REDEFINES there whose data-name-2 does not resolve (an item of another section, the cd-name) is refused by Run with COBOL1654, so no level 01 REDEFINES in the section compiles. The check has no edition arm; the 2023 text has no Communication Section, and the section itself is the 1985 construct. Probed at 85: refused under CD FOR INPUT (the witness), FOR OUTPUT and FOR I-O, on an elementary and a group subject, and across two CDs; a REDEFINES in a level 05 entry of a CD record and two level 01 records without REDEFINES compile.

next.reason: 1985: "This clause must not be used in level 01 entries in the Communication Section."; 2023: "No communication section; SR-13.18.44.3-3 bars REDEFINES only in level 1 file section entries; section lists name only file, WS, LS, linkage". The 2023 data division has no Communication Section: candidate section lists omit it and the REDEFINES rules name only the file section, so this restriction has no counterpart.
